11-Day Best of Turkey Tour: Cappadocia to Antalya
summary:
The 11-Day Best of Turkey Tour moves from Istanbul through the historic Aegean route before adding time on the Mediterranean coast and finishing in Cappadocia. Visit the Gallipoli battlefields and Troy, continue to Pergamon and Ephesus, then see Pamukkale’s white travertine terraces and ancient Hierapolis. Antalya brings a change of pace with its old town and coastal setting before the journey concludes among Cappadocia’s valleys, fairy chimneys and rock-cut settlements.
The tour runs year-round, with dates arranged around your travel plans. Included are selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers and guided sightseeing along the route.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia & Flight to Antalya
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day South Cappadocia tour. Visit Ortahisar Castle, Mustafapaşa, the ancient site of Sobesos Ancient City, and Soganlı Valley. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City. Following the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Antalya. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Perge, Aspendos & Kursunlu Waterfalls
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:00, enjoy a full-day tour of Antalya and the ancient Pamphylia region. Visit Side, Perge, and Aspendos, famous for their impressive Roman ruins and well-preserved theatres. Continue to the scenic Manavgat Waterfall before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale & Hierapolis & Transfer to Kusadasi
itinerary.text: 08:00AM depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus Ancient City
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour to Pergamon & Canakkale
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, depart for Pergamon and explore its impressive Acropolis, including the Temple of Athena, ancient Library, Altar of Zeus, Temple of Trajan, and the world’s steepest ancient theatre. Enjoy views of the Red Basilica before lunch in town. After the tour, continue to Canakkale. Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: Tour to Troy, Gallipoli & Istanbul
itinerary.text: Visit the ancient city of Troy, including the famous Trojan Horse and key ruins. Continue to Eceabat for lunch before the guided Gallipoli campaign Battlefields Tour, visiting Anzac Cove, Lone Pine Memorial, The Nek, and Chunuk Bair. After the tour, transfer to Istanbul. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 11-Day Turkey Holiday Package?
faqs.a: The 11-Day Turkey Holiday Package covers Istanbul, Gallipoli, Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya, and Cappadocia. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, visit the battlefields of Gallipoli, discover the legendary city of Troy, tour the ancient ruins of Pergamon and Ephesus, experience Pamukkale's white terraces, enjoy Antalya's Mediterranean coastline, and explore Cappadocia's fairy chimneys and underground cities. The tour runs for 10 nights and 11 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 11-Day Turkey Holiday Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,095 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights help minimize travel time between destinations and allow you to comfortably experience Turkey's most famous historical, cultural, and natural attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 10 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the itinerary are included.

faqs.q: Does the 11-day Turkey Holiday Package include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want a comprehensive introduction to Turkey. It combines ancient cities, UNESCO-listed sites, Mediterranean scenery, World War I history, and unique landscapes, offering an excellent overview of the country's diverse attractions.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, valleys, and areas with uneven terrain. Sites such as Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia involve moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be arranged as an optional activity. Since balloon flights are weather-dependent and highly popular, advance reservations are strongly recommended to secure availability.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 11-Day Turkey Holiday Package?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 11-Day Turkey Holiday Package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
